_readme: Every key is optional (missing = the README 'Configuration' default). orch.ps1 setup -WriteLocal writes kit.local.json from this file (minus localFiles and _ sections) and each localFiles entry to its path, all git-ignored. Fill the <...> values; forward slashes work on every OS.

_doc._readme: README Configuration rows of keys without a _readme (kittool.py generates the table)
_doc.gitHost, gitHostType, githubHost, gitlab: the git host (type from the host) and the group / owner for short refs <repo>!<iid>
_doc.reposRoot, worktreeRoots, repoAliases, p: checkouts (default the workspace), worktrees (<repos>-wt); short repo names; branches never force-pushed; protectedBranchesMode extend (replace: without main/master/develop)
_doc.commitStyle, locale.cosmeticPattern, loc: subject rule conventional (free / a regex); English defaults: small QA check, testing comment, prose required words ({expected: regex, ...})
_doc.devices: type: android (default) / ios (Simulators, macOS) / none (verbs refuse, app checks NOT_TESTED)
_doc.trackerRepos, trackerLists, productTarge: repos searched for a task's MRs; tracker containers for deploy intest; which env a path needs
_doc.holdMerge: repos (or true = all) whose MRs a person merges (their target deploys): devtools.py merge says NOT_MERGED held for approval
_doc.repos: role producer / consumer; migrations.check = the repo's own migration check (else lbcheck; another tool: UNRUN); deploys[] per env (production: true = never tested): CI branch + job (= target: trunk), tag ({date}), probe + probeField / probeRegex (first group; a URL or command printing the live sha), awsStack + region, ssh {host, key, repoDir, appDir, subdir, exclude, service}, manual, laneApk
_doc.driveParent: Drive folder or shared drive for testing docs and reports (reports.type gdocs)
_doc.supervise: heartbeat: ramActPct, minDiskFreeGB, askOwnerGB (a bigger, idle or growing app: one ASK), ramNames (default _manifest.ram), briefSeconds (one -Brief round)
_doc.idle: README Leases: no live holder for graceMinutes -> released; a board beat counts for beatMinutes
_doc.bugfixMandate, localOnly, orgTerms: words for bug waves; org-only kit paths kept out of git; words the pre-push gate blocks
_doc.findings: required: the QA finding fields (default root_cause, why_today, why_not_prod, db_migration, code_location)
_doc.localFiles: example only: orch.ps1 setup -WriteLocal writes targets.local.json and swarm.config.json from it

tracker._readme: type: none (default) | clickup | github | gitlab | jira (Cloud) | jira-server | linear | azure | youtrack | command. Env: jira JIRA_BASE_URL + JIRA_EMAIL + JIRA_API_TOKEN (jira-server or JIRA_TOKEN), linear LINEAR_API_KEY, azure AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT, youtrack YOUTRACK_URL + YOUTRACK_TOKEN. statuses maps the logical statuses to your board's names (a list = the first is set, all match); statusLabelPrefix: github / gitlab status labels (status:); priorities: names of 1-4, space separated. Examples: _examples.

tracker.owner: <optional: assignee of new tasks; empty = your OS full name matched to a tracker member>
tracker.branchTag: <tag before the task id in branches and MR titles, e.g. CU- / GH- / PROJ- ; default from type>

reports._readme: type: gdocs (Google Doc + Drive evidence via gws; default with gws) | markdown, html, pdf (a kept file; pdf: headless Chrome / Edge or pdfCommand '{in} {out}') | confluence (env CONFLUENCE_URL, CONFLUENCE_TOKEN [+ CONFLUENCE_EMAIL]; space, parent page id) | notion (env NOTION_TOKEN; parent page id) | command (command '<cli> {title} {path} {parent}' printing the URL). share (gdocs): anyone (default) | domain:<domain> | none; confluence / notion: the space / parent page permissions

qa._readme: shutterText / confirmText: camera label regexes. outOfScope: channels agent QA never tests (their steps are OUT_OF_SCOPE: reported, never counted). targets: target groups for /testy select runs (target: '<group>'): per task the first rule whose lists / repos / nameRegex / pathRegex match gives its env (localEnv: a local env, live = in its running release). seatGB: RAM one QA seat promises per kind.
outOfScope: <a channel agent QA never tests, e.g. a chat app, email delivery, an error tracker>

deploy._readme: trigger: owner (default: nobody asks or proposes a deploy; a person says deploy <env> and the coordinator deploys at once) or ask (one batched ask per env, at most one per minIntervalHours: a number, or per target with a default). planTimeoutSec bounds orch.ps1 deploy plan; productionPattern ((?i)prod|critical): production by name when production is unset.

net._readme: timeoutSec per git-host / tracker CLI call; transient errors retry, lost tracker writes wait in .state/outbox.jsonl (supervise replays them)

tests._readme: Per stack (dev.ps1 stack names): the test names -Touched looks for, from a changed source file's base name ({name}). Defaults: maven/gradle {name}Test, {name}Tests, {name}IT; dotnet {name}Tests, {name}Test; python test_{name}, {name}_test; go {name}_test; web {name}.spec, {name}.test.

localEnv._readme: Local envs (local-env skill): the dev flow tests every change here before merge. Any shape: a service is a start command in a folder; envs.<env>.db.engine (postgres, mysql, mariadb, sqlserver, sqlite, oracle, mongodb) + name / user fill the DB hooks. Secrets: <kit>/.state/localenv/<env>.env (dotenv), never here.

db.name: shop
db._readme: engine presets: postgres mysql mariadb sqlserver sqlite oracle mongodb; any hook set here wins

db.clone: <script: a DB server on {+5432} with a copy of the test data>

memory._readme: keepDefault: false = Claude Code auto memory lives in <kit>/memory/ (git-ignored); true = keep the user's own setting.

kitAudit._readme: everyDays: the SessionStart nudge asks for a kitty audit when the last audit is older (default 7; 0 = off).

build._readme: mavenOffline: Maven runs with -o when ~/.m2/repository exists (default true).

gate._readme: Memory gate. keepFreeGB (default 15% of RAM, min 6) = RAM every build leaves free; startHeapGB = first heap for a project with no history; heapMinGB = the floor.

budget._readme: An agent's budget = its tool's default compaction point (orch.ps1 budget; defaults below); handoff at handoffAt x budget; a run's cap = its planned agents' budgets (launch -Self -Plan): an estimate over runStopAt x cap is refused with the split, at runStopAt x cap no new item starts (the rest = next). estimate: per agent / item

claude-1m.source: Claude Code docs: 1M models compact at ~967k

codex.source: 0.9 x the models_cache.json window; auto_compact_token_limit wins

skills/qa-kit/targets.local.json._readme: One entry per TEST environment (never production), the local env included. Passwords live ONLY here. users: <key for qa.ps1 api -As / browser.mjs as> -> [login, password]. auth.type: login (refreshField) | cookie (csrfCookie, csrfHeader) | token | basic | query (param) | command (cmd {method} {url} prints Name: value headers) | none; cert + certPass: mTLS; api may hold {tenant}. browser.portBase (or KIT_BROWSER_PORT_BASE): first of 2000 shared-Chrome debug ports.

skills/android-swarm/swarm.config.json._readme: Lanes = AVD names (swarm.ps1 avd create; iOS: a udid), each with its test login (user: targets.local.json) and notes. avd {abi, api, device, tag}. app.kind: react-native | native | kmp | flutter | maui | capacitor | ios. localManifests: cleartext manifests build -Local merges; localReverse: ports acquire -Apk local reverses (local API).

_manifest._readme: The kit's registry (never copied into kit.local.json): crew, skills, workflows, Router / Events rows, caps. Names live only here: lint checks files against it, kittool.py new / rename / remove edit it, port writes Character blocks and the Crew table. renamed: old -> new (setup -Migrate applies it).

devy.job: builder: makes or changes anything in product repos through the dev flow
devy.cant: deploy, merge into deploy branches, edit the kit

character.bias: the smallest change that passes every goal

revy.job: reviewer: reviews anything and suggests concrete changes

character.bias: assumes a bug until the evidence proves otherwise
character.never: reports a problem without its fix, or edits the artefact itself

checky.job: tester: tests or verifies anything, always with evidence
checky.cant: edit code, leave its target, load shared envs

character.bias: a PASS is unproven until its evidence exists
character.never: trusts a PASS without proof or hides a defect in a note

kitty.job: kit caretaker: the kit and the machine setup
kitty.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, PowerShell, Agent

character.bias: one file, one fact, the smaller diff
character.never: adds a file, a key or a rule another one already covers

buildy.covers: any multi-item build: features, fixes, refactors, migrations, bug waves, resume, duels

testy.covers: any test run: tracker selection, smoke after a deploy, regression sweep, retest, on local or a test env

tidy.covers: kit upkeep: learning signals -> lessons + rule updates, cleanup, the weekly audit kick-off

ram._readme: supervise RAM categories by process name (no .exe), after the kit process trees (kit), then windowsPath (exe path); the rest is unknown, RAM no process owns is windows. supervise.ramNames overrides per key

adapters._readme: README Adapters; code: `adapter:<kind>/<name>` + every verb as a key ('*' = any) up to `adapter-end:<kind>`
